APPROVE
Moving the pin-containment loop, the bench stage and the cached base-arm-at-pin lookup into helpers removes most of the nested branching from `CheckAsync`, which should bring it to 15 or below; the visible logic keeps the same order, conditions, cache use and messages; and the `headPin!`/`atPin` nullability flow should compile cleanly with warnings as errors, though the unshown middle and tail of the method mean the complexity figure and the build are inferred rather than measured.
